Diagnosis: The failure is caused by the runtime validation error: this stage mixed `freeze_orientation` with another orientation constraint, `axis_align`, which is not allowed. To make the smallest valid repair, the `axis_align` hook-monitoring term is removed while keeping the required fixed end-effector orientation term for the release stage.
Reasoning: `freeze_position` keeps `panda_fingertip` fixed at its start-of-stage world position within 0.01 m, satisfying the no-translation requirement. `freeze_orientation` keeps `panda_fingertip` fixed at its start-of-stage world orientation, satisfying the no-rotation requirement. `open_gripper` commands the gripper to open, representing both finger joints reaching the open state and releasing `mug_rim_frame_0`. The hook-preservation axis relation between `mug_handle_hole_frame` and `cup_hanger_branch_1_tip_frame` was representable with `axis_align`, but it cannot be included in the same controller stage as `freeze_orientation` according to the runtime error, so it is noted as unrepresented in this repaired single-stage constraint set. Gripper-specific effort/contact feedback dropping to free-space levels is also not directly representable by the available TermAPI ops; `manipulator_low_effort` is not used because it refers to arm/TCP contact effort, not finger squeeze/contact feedback.
